# Bootstrap, vendored

**Bootstrap 5.3.8**, https://github.com/twbs/bootstrap — **MIT**, the full text
in `LICENSE` beside it.

- `bootstrap.css` — 297 KB, 13,870 lines, UNMINIFIED on purpose: every parity
  finding gets reported against a line number a person can go and read.
- `bootstrap.bundle.js` — 134 KB, the component JS with Popper bundled in.
  Pinned here so the pair travels together; **nothing measures it yet.**

Here as a CORPUS, not as a dependency: nothing the engine ships links or
includes it.

## The first corpus that is CSS

The other three are JavaScript, and they exercise the script engine through a
canvas — which means they say almost nothing about the cascade, and nothing at
all about layout. Every CSS test in this tree before this bundle arrived was a
hand-written inline literal of under ten lines, authored by somebody who already
knew what the engine supported. That is not evidence.

Bootstrap is the opposite, and it was unforgiving on contact: 1,370 `var()`
uses, 1,185 custom-property definitions, 134 `calc()`, 109 `@media` blocks, 93
attribute selectors, 123 pseudo-elements, and a `:root` rule carrying the 128
global custom properties that everything else reads. See
`docs/plans/bootstrap.md` for what that measured and the ladder it produced.

## What loads it

- `examples/pages/bootstrap-*.html` — six fixtures, each isolating one concern,
  linked with `<link rel="stylesheet" href="../../vendor/bootstrap/bootstrap.css">`.
- `tools/check/css-parity.py` — the Chrome comparison. Needs Chrome, run by a
  person, not a ctest.
- `tests/unit/bootstrap_layout.cpp` — the same table generated by ctbrowser
  alone and byte-compared against `tests/baseline/`. Headless and SDL-free, so
  it runs on the devbox.

## Updating the bundle

Replace the files, update `NOTICE` and `vendor/README.md`'s table, and then
**re-measure** — do not assume a newer Bootstrap sits at the same numbers:

```
tools/check/css-parity.py --all          # local, needs Chrome. READ the report.
REGOLDEN=1 ctest --preset default -R bootstrap_layout
git diff tests/baseline/                 # it names the element and the property
```

A number going up is a real finding, not a reason to reach for `--advance`.
